title: 3-Sweep: Extracting Editable Objects from a Single Photo, SIGGRAPH ASIA 2013
summary: A SIGGRAPH Asia 2013 research demo of 3-Sweep, a tool for extracting editable 3D objects from a single photo using a few user strokes. It predates modern AI image tools.
why: HN recalls it as a mind-blowing pre-AI demo of 2D-to-3D object extraction.

quote.text: this single video blew my mind back in *2013* and I find myself thinking about it often.
